summary.headline: Feature update policy requirements include tenant cloud validation
summary.summary: Feature update policy requirements now include shared cloud environment guidance.
summary.adminImpact: Confirm the tenant cloud environment supports feature update policies before rollout.

summary.headline: Quality update policy requirements include tenant cloud validation
summary.summary: Quality update policy requirements now include shared cloud environment guidance.
summary.adminImpact: Confirm the tenant cloud environment supports quality update policies before rollout.

summary.headline: Windows deployment planning now references quality update policies
summary.summary: Windows client planning guidance replaces expedited updates policy references with quality updates policy references.
summary.adminImpact: Use the quality update policy when planning Windows client servicing alongside feature updates.

summary.headline: Government service guidance directs expedited updates to quality update policies
summary.summary: The Government service description now directs expedited update information to Windows quality updates guidance.
summary.adminImpact: Use the quality update policy guidance when assessing expedited updates in government environments.

summary.headline: Settings Catalog filtering guidance separates scope and Android mode selection
summary.summary: Settings Catalog guidance now links user or device scope to its explanation, retains OS Edition examples, and removes the earlier inclusive multi-management-mode explanation and Android filter tip.
summary.adminImpact: Select device or user scope deliberately and validate the management mode before choosing Android settings.
